visual_identity.core_identity: A humanoid upper body fused directly to the body of a giant spider, combining deliberate weapon use with eight-legged arachnid movement.
visual_identity.silhouette: Humanoid torso rising from the front of a broad spider abdomen, eight long spider legs radiating below and around.
visual_identity.head_features: Elven or severe humanoid face with pointed ears; no insect head.
visual_identity.body_shape: Humanlike chest and arms merge at the waist into a giant spider cephalothorax and abdomen.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Two humanoid arms above a fused spider lower body with exactly eight spider legs; no human legs.
visual_identity.surface: Humanoid skin and cloth kept simple; spider lower body uses sparse hair and broad plates.

accuracy_checks: fusion between torso and spider body is clear

known_failure_modes.correction: restore arachnid cephalothorax, abdomen, and exactly eight spider legs

known_failure_modes.symptom: humanoid appears mounted on separate spider
known_failure_modes.correction: make torso visibly fuse directly into spider body

scene_identity.size_impression: Large hybrid with wide eight-legged spread and humanoid torso rising above it.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Supported on multiple spider legs, clinging to broad surfaces, or using web structures with clear contact.
behavior_style: guarding a webbed sacred or ruined space
environment_fit: chapels or chambers with clear arachnid support geometry
